events.title: Defense Of Legends Demo Update
events.summary: Patch Notes: The in-game UI has been redesigned. The Level 2 Physical Archer has been nerfed. The Ice Mage and Spearman have been removed from the demo. Heavy Hand's damage and healing have been slightly increased. The Defense Warrior has been slightly nerfed. Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Portuguese have been added as supported languages. A main menu has been added.

events.title: Defense Of Legends Development Process
events.summary: I have completed the gameplay for levels 1 and 2. I’m planning to make only small changes to the map every 3 levels, such as adding or removing areas, and making minor adjustments by adding or removing small features. After every 3 levels, I want to keep the same stage concept, but change the enemy spawn points, the number of enemies, and the paths they follow. events.title: Defense Of Legends Development
events.summary: Hello everyone,After almost a year, I was finally able to release the demo. The reason the demo took this long is that I wanted to complete the core mechanics of the game as well, which made the process take a bit longer.For Defense Of Legends, I initially plan to release the game in Early Access with 1 Stage, consisting of 18 levels.
